description: This file defines the HttpKernel class within the OrangeHRM installer framework, responsible for configuring and managing the HTTP request lifecycle, routing, session handling, and logging during the installation process.

classes.name: HttpKernel
classes.description: A custom extension of Symfony's BaseHttpKernel tailored for the OrangeHRM installer, handling configuration of the container, logging, routing, sessions, and subscribing to events during the request lifecycle.

methods.name: configureContainer
methods.description: Sets up essential services in the service container such as request stack, router request context, event dispatcher, controller resolver, and argument resolver.

methods.name: configureLogger
methods.description: Initializes the logging system, determining log file writability and log level based on the environment and file permissions.

methods.name: isLogFileWritable
methods.description: Checks whether the log file path is writable by attempting to append an empty string.

methods.name: configureRouter
methods.description: Sets up routing by loading route definitions from a YAML file and adding appropriate listeners.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Loads route definitions from a YAML configuration file and returns a collection of routes.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures session management, including checking directory writability and creating a session object.

methods.name: createSession
methods.description: Creates and returns a Session object with specific options based on request security and base path.

methods.name: configureSubscribers
methods.description: Adds event subscribers, including exception handling.

methods.name: handleRequest
methods.description: Initializes configuration (subscribers, routing, sessions) and processes an incoming HTTP request.

methods.name: isDebug
methods.description: Indicates whether debug mode is active.
